0022600153.text: The Thunder (4-1, 2nd in the Northwest, 5th in the West) visit the Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest, 1st in the West) after a loss in their last game, while Houston is on a five-game winning streak. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Chet Holmgren is listed as day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision. Houston is without Steven Adams (calf strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 112-106 loss to Houston in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
